_meta._note: Wave 1B — Vision-Language agent benchmarks. Adds 6 VL/computer-use/web-nav benchmarks beyond the existing OSWorld family. Strict attribution: every (model_id, benchmark_id, value) row visible on the cited primary source.

benchmarks.name: VisualWebArena (visual web nav)
benchmarks._note: 910 tasks across 3 visually-grounded sites (Classifieds, Shopping, Reddit). Multimodal browser agent SR. Koh et al. ACL 2024.

benchmarks.name: Online-Mind2Web (live web agents)
benchmarks._note: 300 verified tasks across 136 live websites. Auto-eval (WebJudge LLM-judge) + human-verified success rate. OSU NLP. ACL 2025.

benchmarks.name: ScreenSpot-Pro (high-res GUI grounding)
benchmarks._note: 1,581 instructions across 23 professional applications, 5 industries, 3 OSes. Click-coordinate accuracy on uncropped full-screen captures. Li et al. 2025.

benchmarks.name: OS-Copilot / FRIDAY on GAIA
benchmarks._note: Self-improving OS agent with vision. Reports per-level (L1/L2/L3) success rate on GAIA validation set. ICLR 2024 LLM Agents Workshop. arXiv 2402.07456.

benchmarks.name: WebShop (1.18M-product e-commerce nav)
benchmarks._note: 12,087 crowd-sourced shopping tasks over 1.18M real-world products. Task score (partial reward) and success rate. Yao et al. NeurIPS 2022.

benchmarks.name: VisualAgentBench (VAB)
benchmarks._note: 5 environments — VAB-OmniGibson, VAB-Minecraft, VAB-Mobile, VAB-WebArena-Lite, VAB-CSS. Reports per-env and overall success rate. Liu et al. ICLR 2025.
